description_en: Creates a queue for an Enterprise High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster
description_zh: 为指定的E-HPC集群创建队列
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc create-queue --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --queue example-string --api-version 2024-07-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateQueue

fields.description_en: The queue name. The name must be 1 to 15 characters long. It can contain letters from the Unicode letter category, such as English letters and digits, and periods (.).

fields.description_en:
The hostname prefix of the compute nodes in the queue.

><notice>

The prefix can be up to 8 characters in length for Windows operating systems and up to 32 characters in length for Linux operating systems. The prefix can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

></notice>
fields.description_zh:
队列中计算节点的主机名前缀。

><notice>
Windows操作系统前缀字符长度不大于8，Linux操作系统前缀字符长度不大于32，只能由小写英文字母、数字、短横线(-)组成></notice>

fields.description_en:
The ID of the reserved node pool that the queue uses.

> If this parameter is specified, allocatable nodes from the reserved node pool are used to create compute nodes. The `VSwitchIds`, `HostnamePrefix`, and `HostnameSuffix` parameters are ignored.
fields.description_zh:
队列所使用的预设节点池ID。

> 若使用该参数，则会获取预设节点池的可分配节点进行计算节点资源的创建，且同级的`VSwitchIds`、`HostnamePrefix` 和 `HostnameSuffix`参数不会生效。
